instruction: Create a single closed sketch profile shaped like an upside-down U with a semicircular bottom. Draw only these four final edges: a right vertical line from (10, 0) to (10, 20), a top horizontal line from (10, 20) to (-10, 20), a left vertical line from (-10, 20) to (-10, 0), and a lower semicircular arc of radius 10 centered at the origin that runs from (-10, 0) through (0, -10) to (10, 0). Do not leave the straight bottom edge of the square or any other helper geometry in the final sketch. Fully constrain the sketch and save the completed model to /home/user/Unnamed.FCStd.
